reviews.author: Justin Flanders
reviews.text: I can’t say enough good things about these guys! I was completely stuck in the snow and getting nowhere fast, but they showed up quickly and handled everything like total pros. They were friendly, patient, and knew exactly what to do to get my car out safely without causing any damage. Fast response time and fair pricing. If you’re ever stuck in the snow (or anywhere else), this is the company to call. Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Jim Frie
reviews.text: Absolute awesome company! I was stranded roadside with a boat trailer due to a wheel hub that sheared from the axle, leaving the axle unable to accept a new hub. On Demand help us out and recovered the boat and trailer when many other local wrecker companies refused the job. Thank you for your outstanding service!

reviews.author: Jessie M. Biosca
reviews.text: The service and how my son & I were taken care of was phenomenal! I will definitely recommend On Demand Towing. Thank you so much for everything! You have no idea how much this means to me!

reviews.author: Steve Palmer
reviews.text: Great service every time and very quick response time. I called and they where here in 30 min! Definitely would recommend!

reviews.author: Amanda Maxwell
reviews.text: I called Jose at his company when his number was giving to me by another customer at the Wawa that I was at when I locked my keys in my car,he came out right away and not only did he not over charge me he was very nice and patient with me as I had to wait for my father in law to bring me the money for the service. He waiting with me for a good 10 mins for the money and never did he seem bothered about the wait. He was understanding and very kind. I would recommend Jose or his company to anyone who is in need of good, honest professional service!

reviews.author: Jasmin Brown
reviews.text: Wonderful service, called this company and arrive at my location within 15 mins for lock out of vehicle! On time, honesty, friendly and most importantly friendly ! Will definitely use them in future and referrals

reviews.author: Janice Mercer
reviews.text: I was treated with respect and understanding. I like the owner he's a really nice gentlemen. They take good care of your vehicles. I'll call him instead of my insurance co.

reviews.author: Vayneeco Aug
reviews.text: We had towing service in Millville. That was a cold night with some unfortunate but this service went smooth. He sent us back to Edison, NJ with reasonable price. Very friendly stuff. I forgot to ask his name, he’s from Florida. My friends and I really appreciate the help. And thank you for that excellent service.

reviews.author: Min A.
reviews.text: They do a good job and are easy to work with to make the process easy and efficient. Friendly service, too!

reviews.author: Adam Erskine
reviews.text: My daughter and son in law broke down in their Hyundai Santa Fe and these guys came out to tow them. They took a look at the problem and were able to fix it for them right on the side of the road. Super nice guys and came out quick. Cant say enough good about them. They were a Godsend on a cold might!

reviews.author: Aaron Velez
reviews.text: Was told to meet the owner Jose in the morning to make a business deal. I showed up with cash in hand and called because he was a no show, he answers and curses me out for showing up early and cancels the deal. Very unprofessional. I am without a car for another week because of him

reviews.author: Lisa Edmeads
reviews.text: In a time of need they were very helpful with all the questions I had and service was fast and tow operator was very courteous and down to earth and they charge a reasonable fee.

reviews.author: Mary Eli
reviews.text: My boyfriend was in a car accident which was not his fault. His car was towed here. When he went there the next day, he had to pay over $300 to get it out. The car wasn't even there for 24 hours. That is completely ridiculous! That's practically theft. Don't use this place ever. And if the police try to bully you into having your car towed, my advice is if you or someone you know has triple A, use that instead OR leave it on the side of the road. If your car is steal driveable, I would drive it and risk getting a ticket which is much cheaper than the cost of this tow company to keep your vehicle there overnight. And again, the accident wasn't even my boyfriend's fault.

reviews.author: Sally
reviews.text: We needed a tow from Millville to Vineland. It was 6:30 on a Friday night. Looked for towing companies in Vineland. First company said he was talking to another customer and would call us back. Next wasn't working and referred us to another company and guy that answered the phone would come but sounded like he was drunk. Called the first place back and he still couldn't give us an answer when he could come. So I looked for a place in Millville. He said he'd be there in 15 minutes and was there in 10. Very professional and we highly recommend

reviews.author: Julianna T.
reviews.text: horrible service and bull pricing… absolutely ridiculous and owners very unprofessionally. im telling you, call anyone else… or you’ll be paying at least $300+ for the simplest job. save yourself the pain and read the reviews about a place!!

reviews.author: Carlos Flores
reviews.text: My friend and i both had a car to get rid of... Jose the owner offered both of us 350 each over the phone... When he came to me he said he could only do 200 cause of blah blah.. He went to my friends house the next day then offered gim 100 dollars.. So apparently he gives good price over the phone then when he gets there he figures he'll try and take advantage.. Not good business practice

reviews.author: Rera Bovenzi
reviews.text: Amazing company very helpful they went out of their way to help me. Went above and veyond and i couldn't ask for a better service. The only tow company i will use from now on 20 thumbs up

reviews.author: SonnyGTA
reviews.text: The driver came out RIGHT AWAY! VERY friendly and 1/2 the price of other people!! Brand new truck as well! They are going to start towing larger trucks too! I will DEF be using them again!

reviews.author: ian gilligan
reviews.text: Stole from my vehicle that was in storage, then lied about it and said the item was still in the car when it was not. Called the day after it was towed and was told that it was in a spot in the car that it had been left in, however when I went to pick up my belongings, the item was nowhere to be found.

reviews.author: John Michael
reviews.text: I locked my keys in my car and the guys handled it right away at a great price. Thanks so much. Have your number for future

reviews.author: Dora A Wozunk
reviews.text: They were very respectful people. Took care of business very carefully. Very quick with safety in mind.

reviews.author: Redian Caushllari
reviews.text: Very good but they need to lern. I learned samthing in life that we alyes need to lern . Thank you gogle.

reviews.author: adam mierzejewski
reviews.text: Nice when somebody shows up in a newer model year tow truck that's clean... Gave me price upfront did everything he said he would
